86: // Finds the TPU compilation device and execution devices from `devices` for a
87: // TPU computation subgraph. Compilation device is determined from looking up
88: // all TPU_SYSTEM:0 devices and choosing the CPU device associated to the first
89: // TPU_SYSTEM device sorted lexicographically by replica and task. Execution
90: // devices are determined by looking up all TPU devices associated with each
91: // TPU_SYSTEM:0 device found, alongside associated `topology_attr` and
92: // `device_assignment_attr`. If `topology_attr` not an empty string (parsable to
93: // TopologyProto), `device_assignment_attr` must not be empty also. When
94: // `topology_attr` and `device_assignment_attr` are not empty, a general device
95: // assignment based on those two attributes are used. Otherwise when
96: // `topology_attr` and `device_assignment_attr` are empty, a full mesh device
97: // assignment is used instead. A failure will be returned if it is not possible
98: // (e.g. invalid devices or invalid parameters).

102: //   {

105: //     /job:worker/replica:0/task:0/device:TPU_SYSTEM:0,
106: //     /job:worker/replica:0/task:0/device:TPU:0,
107: //     /job:worker/replica:0/task:0/device:TPU:1,
108: //     /job:worker/replica:0/task:0/device:TPU:2,
109: //     /job:worker/replica:0/task:0/device:TPU:3,
110: //     /job:worker/replica:0/task:1/device:CPU:0,
111: //     /job:worker/replica:0/task:1/device:TPU_SYSTEM:0,
112: //     /job:worker/replica:0/task:1/device:TPU:0,
113: //     /job:worker/replica:0/task:1/device:TPU:1,

115: //     /job:worker/replica:0/task:1/device:TPU:3
116: //   }

118: //

120: //   `num_replicas` = 8

123: //   `device_assignment_attr` = {}

128: // `execution_devices` will be:

138: //     },

141: //     },

143: //       /job:worker/replica:0/task:1/device:TPU:0
144: //     },

161: //   `num_cores_per_replica` = 2

87: // Finds the TPU compilation device and execution devices from `devices` for a

89: // all TPU_SYSTEM:0 devices and choosing the CPU device associated to the first
90: // TPU_SYSTEM device sorted lexicographically by replica and task. Execution
91: // devices are determined by looking up all TPU devices associated with each
92: // TPU_SYSTEM:0 device found, alongside associated `topology_attr` and
93: // `device_assignment_attr`. If `topology_attr` not an empty string (parsable to
94: // TopologyProto), `device_assignment_attr` must not be empty also. When
95: // `topology_attr` and `device_assignment_attr` are not empty, a general device
96: // assignment based on those two attributes are used. Otherwise when
97: // `topology_attr` and `device_assignment_attr` are empty, a full mesh device
98: // assignment is used instead. A failure will be returned if it is not possible

103: //   {

109: //     /job:worker/replica:0/task:0/device:TPU:2,
110: //     /job:worker/replica:0/task:0/device:TPU:3,
111: //     /job:worker/replica:0/task:1/device:CPU:0,
